status: Declared before fresh Gazebo trajectories or forecast campaign calculations. Implementation validation tests are separate development evidence.
question: How accurate is an observer-initialized dynamic contact forecast under unchanged 5ms native LQR feedback, across simple motion and a Mars route? Does it add useful information beyond current-estimate persistence and kinematic preview?

live_controller.state_inputs: Exact simulated qpos/qvel and known previous applied commands; no added noise/latency.
live_controller.contact_inputs: Momentum observer, support locator, normal/friction filters only; live-contact/terrain reads forbidden during commands.

scope: 8 new native Gazebo/DART executions; controller unchanged. Forecasts are offline/private diagnostics from exact fresh native histories, not additional Gazebo cases or controller improvements. No iLQR/MPC optimizer change or forecast command activation.
initialization: Existing terrain-informed placement and initial controller reset declared in each provenance. Late slopeX/Y reproduce I30 warm .8s original-goal reanchor and nominal-joint convention; forecasts only after .9s. Other fixed-origin cases start anchors>=.4s. Future reference programs known, future state/contact/terrain not supplied.

forecast.policy: Clone current native controller/observer/locator/filter/synchronizer history after current command; first command passed to avoid duplicate observer update. Advance exactly5ms applied inputs and fine feedback, no20ms averaging.
forecast.model: EstimatedPlanePredictor private MuJoCo local plane/friction frozen within each forecast; cloned observer still updates from predicted states, never solved-contact truth.
forecast.calibration_quality: Retain fit/bracket/bound/residual flags and failures; no truth repair, no tuning. Invalid/unloaded forecasts remain visible in attempted/coverage counts.
forecast.timing: Predicted force/contact output has private last1ms solver-step convention; report timing/filter differences explicitly.
forecast.isolation: Prove clone does not mutate source state/history; reconstruct command/observer/reference history against fresh native trace before forecast. Actual future must run same native policy.

anchors.primary: 12 evenly spaced unique5ms snapped anchors from configured start to actual recorded end minus.2s; partial/failed runs may have fewer, reported.
anchors.event_conditioned: At most8 diagnostic anchors: .100/.050s before first4 stable dominant-family shell↔belt transfers, subject to available history/future. Truth-conditioned window selection is evaluator-only, separate from uniform-primary results; event times never passed into prediction.
anchors.controlled_transfer: Nominate first post-cold stable shell/belt family transfer in flat_y_transfer; isolated only if no other stable family transfer within+/- .100s. If none or isolation fails, label that limitation and retain stress evidence rather than claim a demonstrated isolated transfer. Known lateX is a separate regression.
anchors.no_pseudoreplication: Unique actual event counts deduplicated across anchors; report event forecast coverage and censored endpoints.

contact_metrics.dwell_rule: >=15ms span, four samples at5ms. Backdate onset to first sample, censor insufficient endpoint dwell;3samples span10ms.
contact_metrics.reported: Contact-set agreement/Jaccard, dominant patch/family, transition timing and false/missed/censored forecasts, normalized load-share error, conditional loaded-point error and projected contact-Jacobian lever error; motion XY/orientation/velocity by50/100/200ms. Truth force instant and filtered observer differ in timing.
contact_metrics.multi_contact: Count independently loaded patches above declared threshold; dominant-label accuracy alone is not multi-contact reconstruction.

baselines.observer_persistence: Hold anchor observed patch load vector constant for future set/dominant/loadshare metrics only; no invented future point/lever. Diagnostic baseline, not a changed live controller.
baselines.constant_velocity: Integrate anchor qvel at50/100/200ms, same known geometry/estimatedplane. Compare common motion/conditional geometry observables only.200ms is diagnostic extrapolation beyond current synchronizer horizon.
baselines.existing_synchronizer: Current120ms kinematic exposure/preparation warning; assess chosen-time geometry/exposure and optional incoming-loaded-within120ms warning proxy separately. It has no predicted forces/load distribution, so no force accuracy ranking against it.

trajectory_evaluation: Unchanged original trajectories/goals/timing. Report completion/failure, moving RMS/peak/final error, attitude/saturation. Controlled cases use original final-full1s <=5mm,<=5mm/s,<=2deg reference-lean settling criterion; Mars uses existing route gates. Completion is not gate success.
decision_rule: Diagnostic-only. Report descriptive paired distributions with denominators and per-case/transition strata; no automatic command adoption or arbitrary accuracy-pass promotion. Whether preview improves on existing information must be supported by common-observable comparisons, runtime and outliers, not new trajectory tracking (live controller unchanged).
source_stages: Exact implementation/test/runner/forecast/render sources captured before respective execution; pre_change contains unchanged prior controller sources. Preserve failed development/check runs.
